name: RM-MeTiS Coarsening
aliases: Heavy Edge Matching (HEM) with mapping constraint
Heavy Edge Matching with mapping constraint
definition: A graph coarsening strategy for object-space decomposition that maintains a mapping constraint by distinguishing between 't-nodes' (texture/data nodes) and 'p-nodes' (processor nodes), ensuring each supernode contains at most one p-node.
summary: RM-MeTiS Coarsening is a graph coarsening strategy that maintains a mapping constraint by ensuring each supernode contains at most one processor node, preventing direct processor-to-processor matches.
